// SYNTAX TEST "source.ds"

// types / members / classes constructors and accessors
class Counter {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    public readonly value: int32;
    constructor(readonly label: string) {}
    get count(): int32 { return this.value; }
}

// types / members / interfaces objects and index signatures
interface Dictionary {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    readonly [key: string]: string;
    name?: string;
    (key: string): string;
}

// types / members / enums structs and newtypes
struct Point {
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
    x: float64;
    y: float64;
}

newtype NonEmptyString = string;
// <- keyword.declaration.type.ds
